candidates.title: Unsettled
blockers: The complete governing official rules corpus for the updated framework plus Planets 001 and 002 was not retrievable from an official Orange Nebula-controlled endpoint.
Only one of three governing rule authorities was acquired, and that updated framework rulebook came from a retailer mirror rather than an official publisher endpoint.
Only one meaningful source-linked visual was receipted; a promotable visual packet requires four to eight distinct reduced references and a contact sheet.

coverage.methodology: Edition scope is the updated Unsettled framework printed for the 2023 campaign with the retail bundle's Planets 001 and 002. Rules denominator counts three required governing authorities: the complete updated framework rulebook, the complete Planet 001 rules-bearing corpus, and the complete Planet 002 rules-bearing corpus. Factual denominator counts ten declared claim groups in evidence.json; reviews and opinions carry zero factual weight.

gap.threshold_summary: Rules coverage is 33.3% (1 of 3 governing authorities) versus the required 100%; factual coverage is 60% (6 of 10 declared claim groups) versus the required 60%, but official provenance and visual gates also remain unmet.
missing_evidence: An official publisher-hosted copy of the complete updated framework rulebook, not merely the receipted campaign product description and retailer mirror.
The complete rules-bearing content for Planet 001 Wenora and Planet 002 Grakkis, including their planet-specific special rules and survival tasks.
Four to eight licensable or narrowly transformed, meaningful visual references with receipts, distinct subjects, hashes, and a contact sheet.
Authoritative exact component manifests for the updated framework, Planet 001, and Planet 002.

attempted_sources.result: The official Orange Nebula page returned HTTP 429 local_rate_limited to scripted retrieval and an empty browser document during this run.
Retrieved successfully; it identifies an Updated Rulebook included in every framework printed for that campaign, but the linked document itself was not exposed as a retrievable official file.

Retrieved and inspected all 48 pages of the 2023-03-14 updated framework rulebook, but this is a retailer-hosted mirror and it does not contain the complete Planet 001 or Planet 002 rules-bearing corpora.
The official sitemap request returned no bytes during the rate-limited retrieval window, so it could not close the publisher document inventory.
The review rendered in the browser and supplied a meaningful gameplay photograph, but scripted HTML retrieval was blocked by Mod_Security.

help_requested: T, please provide or authorize a publisher-hosted updated framework rulebook URL and complete Planet 001 Wenora and Planet 002 Grakkis rules-bearing materials for this edition.
T, please provide permission-cleared official component and gameplay images, or approve exact official asset URLs suitable for four distinct reduced editorial references.
